description: After fz-sc8.129, drive_product_fact_waits_with_sessions (src/compiler2/product_drive.rs) still carries 'if sessions.is_none() { driver.apply_fact_movements(&delivered_facts(..)) }' on job completion. sessions is None only from cfg(test) wrappers (drive_product_fact_wait, drive_product_fact_waits, drive_root_product_with_producers); every production path passes Some(sessions). That arm is test-only scaffolding in production code, and since .129 the drain no longer feeds quiescence movements to the driver in that mode, so the tests exercise a half-path production never runs. Move those tests onto the production path (real ProductSessions), delete the Option and the arm, and delete the wrappers if nothing else uses them.
title: The product fact-wait pump has no test-only no-sessions arm
